title: Bright 2BR with sunny balcony near campus
description: A 5-minute walk to the City University north gate. Sunny south-facing balcony, fully furnished with new beds and a study desk in each room. Popular with graduate students. Third floor with no elevator.

title: Compact studio above a cafe
description: Small furnished studio right on Cafe Street, 3 minutes from campus. Great location and price, but the cafe below is noisy until late.

title: Spacious 3BR, perfect for roommates
description: Three equal-sized bedrooms and two bathrooms, ideal for sharing. 10-minute walk to the university. Building has an elevator and one parking spot. Unfurnished.

title: Quiet 2BR on a side street
description: On a calm side street away from Cafe Street, 8 minutes from campus. Large windows and an elevator, pets allowed. No balcony.

title: Modern 1BR with small balcony
description: Newly built block with an elevator. Modern kitchen, small balcony, fully furnished. 7-minute walk to the university library.

title: Ground-floor 2BR with garden patio
description: Ground-floor flat with a private garden patio instead of a balcony. Pet-friendly with one parking spot. 10 minutes on foot to campus.

title: Historic 2BR with wrought-iron balcony
description: Charming apartment in a restored stone building with high ceilings and an old wrought-iron balcony over Clock Tower Square. 12-minute walk to the university south gate. Street noise on weekend nights.

title: Renovated 3BR loft
description: Open-plan loft with exposed wooden beams, fully furnished, balcony with rooftop views. Near the Old Market. Third floor, no elevator.

title: Cozy 1BR near the Old Market
description: Small but cozy furnished one-bedroom a few steps from the Old Market. Good value, 15 minutes on foot to campus.

title: Affordable 2BR above a bakery
description: Simple two-bedroom above a family bakery. Smells great in the morning. Unfurnished, no balcony, 14-minute walk to the university.

title: River-view 2BR with large balcony
description: Seventh-floor apartment with a large balcony overlooking the river. Fully furnished, two bathrooms, secure parking and 24/7 security.

title: Luxury 3BR penthouse with terrace
description: Top-floor penthouse with a wraparound terrace, panoramic river views, designer furniture and two parking spaces.

title: 1BR garden apartment
description: Quiet ground-floor flat with a small private garden, a 2-minute walk to the River Walk. Pet-friendly.

title: Family 3BR near the River Walk
description: Spacious family apartment with a balcony, near the River Walk and Riverside Hospital. Unfurnished, with parking and an elevator.

title: Studio next to Central Metro
description: Furnished studio a 2-minute walk from Central Metro Station. Ideal for commuters. Small, with street noise.

title: City-view 2BR with balcony
description: Ninth-floor apartment with a balcony and skyline views, fully furnished, 5 minutes from Central Metro Station and City Mall.

title: 2BR in an older building near City Mall
description: Good-value two-bedroom with a small balcony in an older building behind City Mall. 6 minutes on foot to Central Metro Station, then 15 minutes by metro to the university. No elevator.

title: 1BR executive apartment
description: Stylish furnished one-bedroom in the Business Towers with a gym, parking and a balcony.

title: 3BR family apartment with balcony
description: Large family apartment near the International School, with a balcony, two parking spots and a shared garden.

title: 2BR overlooking Central Park
description: Quiet two-bedroom with a balcony facing Central Park. Pet-friendly, with parking. 35-40 minutes by bus to the university.

title: 4BR duplex with private garden
description: Two-floor duplex with a private garden, an upstairs balcony and a garage. Ideal for large families.

title: Budget 2BR near the train station
description: Very affordable two-bedroom with a balcony, 5 minutes from the Main Train Station. Some railway noise. Fourth floor, no elevator. 30 minutes by bus to the university.

title: Large 3BR in a renovated block
description: Lots of space for the price in a freshly renovated building with an elevator and parking. Balcony faces the Industrial Zone.

title: Basic 1BR
description: No-frills one-bedroom, the cheapest option in the city. Near Eastgate Market.
